summary: The body clip each bending move casts with (BendPoses.pick; SwayPose plays it for the player, NpcBody.play_cast for a bot), and when its strike leaves (strike_s: SwayCaster lands a bolt, a throw, a cone, a ring or a shove then). Only in element mode (a duel or a ring match with the player's element chosen): the open world keeps the mastery tier clips (SwayPose.clip_for). Our own clips only (docs/animation_provenance.md, animations/SOURCE.md): no imported clip, nothing measured off a reference (fit_ref.gd). The own ring-sport clips (animations_extra/Frontier_Bend.res: tools/anim_author/blender/bend_clips.py) pose every element's moves and stand in its stance; the older own clips (the Form casts, the forage grab) keep the few moves no own bend clip fits yet.

_doc.pick: BendPoses.pick(move, mode, element): moves[move].modes[mode], else moves[move].pose, else cast[element] (only for a move with a bend spec for that mode: the Sway's old spells keep their tier clip unless mapped here), else {} (the caller plays SwayPose.clip_for). A clip missing from every own library, or in exclude, is passed over to the next.
_doc.pose: A clip's name, or {clip, mask, hand, root, alt, hold_s, strike_s, back_s, legs_always}; what it leaves out comes from clips[clip], then the clip's own metas.
_doc.clips: Timing and play rules for clips whose library does not carry them (the interim clips were made before strike_s): hold_s (the moment held while the lock fills), strike_s (the moment the move leaves, on the release's clip), back_s (where a broken lock eases out from), hand (the limb the move leaves from: l_palm, r_palm, both, l_foot, r_foot), mask (ToolPose: upper, reach_l, reach_r, full), root (the caster held still while it plays), then (a release played as another clip: the floor cast's press then its stand), press_s (a bot plays the whole clip: its strike there).
_doc.stance: Each element's stance loop (own-bend-stance-<element>): SwayPose loops it under the casts while the player casts as that element and stands still with his hands free; NpcBody plays it as an element bot's idle. Stance idles only: no gait.
_doc.combo_window_s: Casts this close chain: the same move in the same variation locked again within this many seconds of its last cast takes its pose's alt (the next hand), then its own clip again (SwayPose; a bot takes the alt every other cast).

exclude_why.own-axe-d: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json axe_d has a 'fit' record: its key poses were measured off atk-pipe-1-side-swing-intro/-miss (tools/anim_author/fit_ref.gd); the clip's own 'source' meta says so
exclude_why.own-axe-w: axe_w has a 'fit' record: measured off atk-pipe-3-to-knee-hit-intro/-hit (fit_ref.gd)
exclude_why.own-axe-parry: tools/anim_author/author_parry.gd builds every key from axe_d's first key (guard.duplicate(true), only the hips' and chest's yaw and the tool changed), and that key is one of the fitted ones; the clip's 'source' meta reads 'none: not extracted from any game', which does not record that input. Held back until the owner decides (2026-10-04, T4)
exclude_why.own-axe-block-high: tools/anim_author/author_high_block.gd starts and ends on axe_d's first key, a fitted pose (as the parry); held back until the owner decides
exclude_why.own-club-stab: tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd takes the club's grip from axe_d's first key's tool (a fitted pose); own-axe-stab, whose grip comes from the carry clip instead, stands in for it

_own_bend: Our own ring-sport clips (animations_extra/Frontier_Bend.res, tools/anim_author/blender/bend_clips.py; the first ten approved by the owner 2026-10-05, the second set authored the same way after it): their timing (hold_s, strike_s, back_s, up_s) is the clips' own metas; the rows above name the limb the game knows, the mask (the casts on the upper body with the legs as far as the caster stands still; the stomps, the boulder, the raise and the kick whole and rooted; the burrow and the spin whole while moving, legs_always) and whether the caster is rooted. Earth: the stomp (Rock Jab stomp, Earth Wall shell, Earth Grip), the boulder (Stone boulder: the owner's 'left kick to stomp and then push'), the raise (Earth Wall wall and column), the rise (Rock Jab kick-up, Pillar), the burrow (Earth Skate), the shove (Earth Shove push, Catch deflect), the push (Shove split), the catch (Catch catch, Shove pull). Fire: the punch (Fire Blast punch and fireball, Fire Jab jab), the double jab (stream, double jab), the kick (Fire Arc kick), the sweep (Fire Arc sweep, embers, Fire Wall wall, Parry), the breath (Breath, inferno, flare), the lightning (its long charge). Water: the whip (Water Whip, Water Jet, Redirect), the wave (Wave), the draw (Flow, Frost, Ice freeze), the shield (Water Shield, freeze water); Ice spear and shards the throws. Air: the palm (Air Palm, Redirect), the sweep (Air Blast ball and vacuum, trip, dust), the spin (Evade spin, cyclone, tornado, Fire Wall ring), the leap (Air Jump, the dashes and hops of every element), the shield circle (Air Shield, cushion); Air Blast slice the sidearm throw. A pose with an alt (its mirrored twin) chains to the other hand. The knocks are SwayPose's knock layer, not casts.
